findings.title: close_task atomicity gap — partial write possible
findings.suggested_fix: If complete_task's safe_write raises ConflictError after judge_task has already persisted judge.md, system is left in inconsistent state. Document as known limitation or wrap in transaction-like pattern.

residual_risks: Tier 2 stub bypass: All Tier 2 results return passed=True. When v0.2 implements real verify_cmd execution, existing tasks with failing verify_cmds will suddenly fail at close time. No migration path or warning exists.
requirements field type change: CognitiveTriad.requirements changed from list[str] to list[Requirement]. Parser handles backward compat, but any external tooling writing raw YAML will silently break.
